name: Reeds
note: Reeds (cattail-like; docs 10, 14). habitat: each axis is [ideal low, ideal high, tolerance]: full suitability inside the ideal range, falling to 0 a tolerance beyond it. moisture and salt are 0..1 from the habitat grid; waterDepthM is standing fresh water at mean tide (the sea counts as far too deep). growth: size grows toward 1 at ratePerH x suitability x the season's rate (spring, summer, autumn, winter), so sprout to mature takes about 30 game hours in summer; stages by age in hours (seed until sprout) and size; a plant whose suitability stays under lowSuit for lowHours shrinks toward floor x its best size; a seed that has not sprouted dies after seedDieHours in poor ground; under more than drownDepthM of water for drownHours it dies. flowering: season positions (0 spring .. 4) when mature clumps carry seed heads; dormant: when they stand as pale stalks. spread: a mature clump with suitability over minSuit sends a rhizome every everyH hours, distanceM away along the best of 8 bearings, if no clump stands within minSpacingM there. starter: a new island starts with count mature clumps on the most suitable cells, spacingM apart. shape and season: the look (flora-draw.wgsl); season albedo is physical (linear). Stems: stemsPerClump grows with size, at r = clumpRadius x u from the clump center (denser in the middle), the clump spreading from radiusMin of clumpRadius when new; stem height = maxHeight x size, varied by heightVar, outer stems up to edgeShorter shorter; leanDeg is the rest lean (hashed direction, fanned outward), dormantLean times that for pale dormant stalks; stems start sinkM below the bed. Seed heads (flowering clumps): on headShare of stems, their top headGapM below the stem tip. wind: sway is the tip bend per unit wind (share of height); stiffness 0..1 keeps the base straight (the bend grows as level^(1 + 3 x stiffness)); gustM is the size of passing gusts, gustSpeed their speed (m/s). look: sproutM is the shortest a stem stands, so a new clump is visible, and a seed shows as seedShoots shoots that tall; rootShade darkens the sky fill at the base, wetDarken is the albedo factor in rain, pixelWidth keeps far stems at least that many pixels wide.
